subject: [PATCH v6 01/12] mm: rename pmd_to_softleaf_folio() to pmd_softleaf_to_folio()

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the rename as a valid correction and gave an ACK.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Reviewed the patch and gave a Reviewed-by, noting it was a valid correction.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: LGTM and gave a Reviewed-by, indicating the patch is good to go.
reviews.raw_body:
On 18 Aug 2026, at 9:09, Usama Arif wrote:

> pmd_to_softleaf_folio() converts the softleaf entry encoded by a PMD
> to a folio. Rename it to pmd_softleaf_to_folio() to make the conversion
> direction explicit and align it with softleaf_to_folio().
>
> No functional change.
>
> Suggested-by: Dev Jain <dev.jain@arm.com>
> Signed-off-by: Usama Arif <usama.arif@linux.dev>
> ---
>  include/linux/leafops.h | 4 ++--
>  mm/huge_memory.c        | 2 +-
>  2 files changed, 3 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)
>
LGTM.

Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>

Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch with an ACK, showing agreement.

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch renames the function pmd_to_softleaf_folio() to pmd_softleaf_to_folio() in the mm/huge_memory.c file and its corresponding header include/linux/leafops.h, making the conversion direction explicit. The change is a simple rename with no functional changes.
